independent_planning_review.head: f69a4e140bda2850df6ca3de4e9210ec261bd646
independent_planning_review.independent_method: Used git ls-tree and git show of the exact tree, not staged worktree. Parsed canonical English translatable string elements and locale XML independently; enumerated literal R.string references in main Kotlin/Java; compared all 295 key records, missing locale sets, source English, manifest tiers and consumer path/line/code sets. Consumer ordering ignored as immaterial.
scope_caveats: 18 describes incomplete exact offered catalogues, not every Android resource folder. Legacy values-es and values-ko are also partial but neither bare es nor ko is a picker option; offered regional/script variants have complete direct key presence.
4,775 counts locale-key pairs, not unique controls; 295 counts shared missing keys.

Literal R.string references establish source references, not execution or visibility in every app state. They can include comments/dead code and miss dynamic/indirect sources or XML references; no runtime certification.
No-reference category is better read as no literal production Kotlin/Java reference found, not proven unreachable catalogue-only.
P2/P3 are current manifest classifications, not a new risk judgment or translation-quality approval. Long safety/attribution prose may merit special care even when manifest says P2.
Presence is not translation completeness in semantic terms; aliases, inherited fallback and correctness require separate evaluation. No plurals/arrays counted in string-only totals.

next_research_groupings.reason: Bounded shared page-selector context; research ordinal identifier, preview noun and range instruction separately in each locale. Preserve placeholders and distinguish page count from page number.

Short coherent layout actions with concrete selector semantics. Separate alignment from width/height changes and writing direction. Exclude already prepared Wolof top/bottom values until reconciliation.

Useful small action/result/failure family. Establish attribution meaning before composition, distinguish it from financial credit; completed aspect and neutral failure need own review. Leave long legal licence instructions out of this bounded group.

limits: Evidence-only planning; no translations, application changes, tests, external mutation or permanent approval mirror added.

remaining_gap_planning.classification: Read-only current-source planning, not new translation/behavior/completion credit; literal references are not exhaustive runtime reachability.

next_preparation.status: Independently model-reviewed preparation only; not applied or CI-qualified; excluded from merged counts
next_preparation.next_action: After #484 integration, freshly reconcile actual develop, owners and holds before applying any candidates. Keep preparation separate from current merged coverage.

limits: Model/source review is not native-human, whole-language or exhaustive installed-layout/TalkBack acceptance.
Primary lexical and instructional evidence corroborates targeted terms, not every complete original UI phrase; catalogue anchors are consistency evidence rather than proof.

Regional and spelling variants remain documented; palette wording is accepted as a colour-box metaphor, not standardized dictionary terminology. The original prerequisite deferral remains preserved. Other unproposed uncertainties are not blanket locale holds.
Python totals include skipped bodies; consult the exact regression receipt rather than interpreting the runner total as all executed passes.
Build/source, test-APK and core-only ZIP bytes were not independently downloaded here; hosted composition/preflight verified their byte/source binding.
All holds, the separate #422 approval operation, Work-side tasks and release destinations were untouched.
